title: רב אסי בר' חנינא

paragraphs: Rav Assi son of Rabbi Chanina, Bekhorot 34, end of b. Rav Acha bar Rav Avya sat before Rabbi Assi and reported a teaching in the name of Rav Assi bar Chanina. The checked Bava Batra 56a reads Rabbi Assi bar Chanina. Bava Batra 129b and 133a–b cite Rav Acha’s separate inheritance report. Jerusalem Megillah 1:9:5 [cited here as 1:11]: Rabbi Zeira in the name of Rabbi Immi bar Chinena. Perhaps the two names refer to the same person.
